activity.text: Validated live `scan` acquisition over USB CDC on firmware 1.2.44. Command `scan 140000000 150000000 11 7` returned 11 rows in the format frequency_hz, S11 real/imag and S21 real/imag. Raw and structured golden fixtures were added for Bridge parser development.
